items.title: Make the INIT_CHECK phase write atomic with worktree bootstrap
items.context: cli-engine.ts:4003 writes phase=INIT_CHECK before dev_start bootstraps the worktree (:4010); on bootstrap failure there is no rollback (:4022-4024). Defer the phase persistence until bootstrap succeeds, OR roll the phase back (and any mirror) if bootstrap throws, so a failed bootstrap never leaves a partially-advanced story.
items.userSees: When worktree bootstrap fails, `lattice story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK` reports failure and the story stays at its prior phase (story_get shows the original phase, not INIT_CHECK) instead of 'advanced to INIT_CHECK' followed by a worktree-failed warning.

happy.desc: On a clean repo, story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK with a succeeding bootstrap advances phase to INIT_CHECK and creates the worktree (unchanged success behavior)

edge.desc: When dev_start bootstrap throws, story_get still shows the prior phase (INIT), not INIT_CHECK; output reports failure not advancement

adversarial.desc: A victim already at INIT_CHECK with no worktree re-runs story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK: does not throw INIT_CHECK->INIT_CHECK, re-runs dev_start, no double-advance

items.title: Add a supported recovery path for stories already stuck without a worktree
items.context: core/machine.ts:503-508 has no INIT_CHECK->INIT backward transition, so a story stuck with requiresWorktree=true and no worktree on disk cannot be re-bootstrapped or rolled back today. Add an idempotent re-bootstrap (or guarded re-entry) command/path that recreates the worktree for such a story.
items.userSees: For a story stuck in INIT_CHECK with no worktree, a documented recovery command recreates the worktree and prints its path, instead of 'Cannot transition from PLAN to INIT_CHECK' with no way forward.

happy.desc: lattice dev_start {storyId} on a story stuck in INIT_CHECK with no worktree on disk recreates the worktree and prints its path

edge.desc: lattice dev_start is idempotent: running it when the worktree already exists returns the existing path without error

adversarial.desc: lattice dev_start is refused in REVIEW/TEST/DONE phases and refused for an INIT story that has not passed the scope-anti-expansion freeze gate

items.title: Add regression tests for non-atomic advance and recovery
items.context: Cover: (a) a forced bootstrap failure leaves the phase unchanged (no partial advance); (b) the recovery command re-creates a missing worktree for an already-stuck story. Use the existing worktree/cli-engine test seams; do not require a real failing bootstrap if it can be injected.
items.userSees: `lattice validate` runs the new tests green, proving bootstrap-failure leaves phase unchanged and the recovery path re-bootstraps a stuck story.

happy.desc: New smoke test runs green under lattice validate, asserting bootstrap-failure leaves phase unchanged and the recovery path re-bootstraps a stuck story

edge.desc: The injected bootstrap-failure path does not require a real failing git operation (uses an injectable seam) yet still exercises the cli-engine ordering

adversarial.desc: Test guards against regression: if phase were advanced before bootstrap, the partial-advance assertion fails loudly
